name: Shiina Yuki
source:
[u][b]"No way I was getting you to bed, so I just dumped you on the sofa — no hard feelings, okay?"[/b][/u]

She is the [url=/c153765]protagonist[/url]'s roommate, his friend since high school, and his [b]ex-girlfriend[/b].
They started dating more out of comfort than romantic feelings—simply because being together felt easy. Eventually, [b]they drifted apart just as casually[/b], realizing little would change whether they dated or not.

Despite this past relationship, they remain on excellent terms—far from hostile, even exceptionally close. They share moments of near-telepathic understanding, existing in that ambiguous space of "more than friends, less than family."

[b]She has a decisive personality to the extent of even startling men, and never hesitates to reject what she dislikes.[/b]

[Translated from [url=https://www.hook-net.jp/weekend/character/]official website[/url]]
